notes: All numeric risk limits are explicit illustrative research assumptions, not calibrated optimal limits or the user's actual portfolio.
Preserve A+ 30%, A++ 35%, and every existing formal evidence gate.
No subjective scenario weights are treated as calibrated probabilities.
No actual stock purchase, sale or broker order is authorized by this file.
cost_policy_notes: Fee and tax rates are declared research inputs; brokerage discounts and the user's actual account costs are not assumed verified.
Slippage is 10 basis points on each side and half-spread is 5 basis points on each side. These are fixed assumptions, not measured historical fills or optimized estimates.
The policy enters a newly hashed prospective registration at its actual registration time; previous null-cost registrations remain immutable and are not backdated.

For retrospective studies the same inputs are labelled post-hoc research assumptions. The minimum fee is a fixed NTD 20 per side research assumption; actual account terms, personal dividend/income tax and trading constraints remain unverified.
